crossRefs.note: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You…
Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women…
